name: Privatzimmer Ritzer
beschreibung: The Gasthof Ritzer is located in the center of Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterland. The alpine-style house offers simple private rooms equipped for an uncomplicated stay. Guests can expect a traditional inn atmosphere with regional cuisine and personal service. The location allows excursions into the Kaiserwinkl-Region as well as explorations of the neighboring Bavarian countryside. Parking is available, and arrival by public transport via Kufstein is possible.
